place.name: Huilo-Huilo Biological Reserve
place.description: Huilo-Huilo Biological Reserve (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈwilo ˈwilo] , Pronounced: WEEL-oh-WEEL-oh) is a private for profit natural reserve and ecotourism area in southern Chile. It is by the community of Neltume along the international road to Hua Hum Pass near the border to Argentina.
